scope: Exactly the final manuscript’s 23 ordered sources: 21 peer-reviewed papers and two official regulatory documents.
methods: Each paper title, first author, journal, year, DOI and PMID matched Europe PMC and Crossref metadata. Data checked by reading actual metadata, not HTTP status alone.

excluded_app_only_source.reason: Not one of the final manuscript’s 23 sources; not reassigned to another article. Consumer drug-reference mappings must remove or separately label this source.
